subject: [hw] DONE X01: op log, log2script, diff_logs; 433/433 (ASan/O2/TSan, literal log, round trip, iOS compile)
body:
DONE X01. Host-tested only; no phone, no publish, no daemon edit; commit 0bbb7ae (hwlog/** + dsh-state/workers/X01/STATUS.md).

Acceptance:
    bash gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/run_tests.sh
    N2TEST X01 PASS 433/433

Full run, 15.6 s, everything under /tmp/n2hw-X01 (340 KB):
    asan basic 36/36, replay 36/36, mutate 36/36, errors 39/39, threads 14/14; literal expected log by diff; reads and full replay log identical
    o2   basic 36/36, replay 36/36, mutate 36/36, errors 39/39, threads 14/14; same diffs
    tsan basic 36/36 + threads 14/14 (no TSan report)
    cap0-asan trunc 9/9, cap0-o2 trunc 9/9  (last line: 1000000 HWLOG truncated limit_bytes=0 bytes=0 dropped=5)
    python checks 33/33 (script/summary content, raw T02 logs, malformed input, pool-base normalisation, masked writes, lengths)
    arm64-apple-ios16.0 compile with build_ios.sh exact freestanding flags (-nostdinc, video/sdk/sysinc, -Werror)

Implemented:
- hwlog/n2vc_hw_log.c/.h: n2vc_hw_wrap_log(out, inner, path), forwards every call unchanged (NULL out_done/status forwarded too), T02 recorder syntax + us timestamp + result per op. POWER; each batch op with the read value; POLL ok/timeout; wait_irq status/timeout; irq_clear; DMA alloc/free with pa; dma_rw offset/bytes + CRC-32 (never data). Mutex, stdio buffering, fflush+fsync+fclose, N2HW_HWLOG_MAX_MB=16 default with one final HWLOG truncated line.
- hwlog/log2script.py: T02 script (one-shot read overrides, irq status, irq fires K ms after the logged write) + per-register summary for facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md.
- hwlog/diff_logs.py: first divergent write, timestamps ignored, DMA addresses normalised by each log pool base (inferred or --base-a/-b), --all for every op.
- hwlog/README.md: exact phone steps and which file to copy back.
- hwlog/STATUS.md + dsh-state/workers/X01/STATUS.md: honest list.

Not done / limits (full list in STATUS):
- No phone run and no product vcodecd link. The 3-line N2HW_HWLOG hook, build_ios object lines and the one missing libSystem symbol `_fileno` are posted to hw-ip; until they land vcodecd ignores the variable.
- No real vendor log converted yet; summary rows not added to facts/VENC_PROTOCOL.md (read-only for me, owner opus-venc/hw-d01).
- POLL has no reads=N (not observable through the frozen callback). DMA alloc bytes is the requested size, not T02s page-rounded size. IRQ delay is write-to-wait timestamp difference, one rule per (irq, trigger) with the first delay. A timed-out POLL does not invent a read value; a replay where the array already matches warns and will succeed.
- T02 fake still models VENC/VENC_C1 as 0x2000 while K02 rev 3 uses 0x3000; log2script accepts 0x3000 so a phone log is not filtered, but a replay rule above 0x1ffc is rejected by the current fake. Posted to hw-t02; the frozen header comment (0x2000) is posted to hw-lead.

Interfaces used: include/n2vc_hw.h only; T02 tests/hw read only. Files changed: gpu/hwcodec/hwlog/** (12 files) and dsh-state/workers/X01/STATUS.md. CLOCK_MONOTONIC is the phone timestamp source. I stay available for review findings.
